changes: Owner-directed monthly standard prices: Basic/Feeds USD9, Pro USD49 and Max USD99
New Pro checkout selects the verified USD49 monthly Price; prior Price identities and existing entitlements remain accepted
Unavailable Basic/Max checkout plans are refused before customer creation or provider effects
Exact singular head-start hero, current architecture and North Star reconciliation
Bounded public Greenhouse metadata intake behind the existing source edge, with shared quota accounting
Source URL normalization removes fbclid without losing resource-identifying query parameters
Daily revision watch expanded to 48 sources under its 50-source bound

billing.rollback_requirement: Keep both accepted Price identities and the v2-capable billing reader. Reverting new checkout selection must not revoke the new Price or existing grants. Match public pricing to the chosen checkout policy.

edge_readback.scope: Exact exported bodies, required headers and export identity

live_full_public_route_map.finding: One phone/light documentation view had no heading at the checker's fixed 1.5-second observation. All other recorded views passed.

route_followup.conclusion: The checker can observe the asynchronous page before it is ready. The original fetch timing was not captured, so its exact transport cause is unknown. A visible loading state and bounded readiness check remain follow-up work.

retained_failed_attempts: Independent attempt 01 had a native-fetch edge-status timeout and one health transport failure, omitted a host and correctly failed coverage. Complete attempt 02 passed all ten hosts.
Full-route attempt 01 stopped before browsing because the read-only guard received an absolute log path instead of its required basename. The corrected invocation completed as attempt 02.

Full-route attempt 02 retained the one asynchronous heading failure. Three isolated live repeats passed; a delayed-index control reproduced the race and a cleared heading still failed. Do not relabel the original report as passing.
Pulse attempt 01 passed readiness but recorded two slow responses. Fresh attempt 02 passed with none.

An initial local pre-push selection used unsupported short shard aliases and did not run those shards. The corrected explicit four-shard run passed; a separate fail-closed selector repair is pending integration.
The initial hardcoding gate identified eight new source URLs. Exact reviewed registry allowances resolved them; the complete repeat reported no new high findings.
limits: Public browser checks use emulated viewports and do not qualify every authenticated journey, provider or customer task.
No live charge or subscription migration was performed to test checkout.
The research-watch failure-visibility repair is not included in this revision; an expanded watch is not proof of successful recurring collection from every source.
Greenhouse qualification covers metadata intake, not job descriptions, generated components or daily production volume.
Separate popularity/agent-use rankings, bounded recursive research automation and comprehensive decision feeds remain unfinished.
No catalogue additions, body-store migration, hosted Max execution or two-million-file milestone were published by this release.
